feature: Group colour-space eligibility, defaults, remapping and inheritance
source_rule: /CS is optional except required for a group with no parent space (including a luminosity soft-mask group); ordinarily only isolated groups specify it. Otherwise inherit parent's/page's blending space. Supported spaces must meet §11.3.4 constraints; device spaces are remapped through DefaultGray/RGB/CMYK.

feature: Initial backdrop and internal state reset
source_rule: A non-isolated group starts from accumulated parent/page color and alpha within BBox (or parent initial backdrop when immediate parent is knockout); isolated starts transparent. Before member execution reset BM=Normal, CA=ca=1, SMask=None so these values are applied once at group composition.
assertion_quality: Display-list tests check inner defaults and outer group state; pixel tests distinguish isolated/non-isolated backdrop behavior. The reset test's visible assertions do not isolate soft-mask reset or every outer-state restoration interaction.
verdict: supported for asserted BM/alpha and selected backdrop cases
residuals: No test located that independently targets SMask reset for a group while also checking the invocation mask is applied once.

feature: Group compositing as an elementary object, BBox clipping and caller-state conversion
source_rule: Group members composite internally under /K; final result is the union of member shapes clipped by BBox and painted once using accumulated group colour/opacity. Color conversion out uses invocation rendering intent and black point compensation; graphics state reverts after Do.
assertion_quality: The once-versus-per-object pixel case has an independent manual expected color, and BBox test checks pixels inside/outside. Conversion coverage is extensive for selected spaces. No directly located test asserts all caller graphics state restoration fields after Do.
verdict: supported for sampled final-composite and BBox behavior
residuals: Invocation-state restoration across all relevant fields and both rendering intent/black point compensation combinations not certified here.
